parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside under `Tests/` directory paths (`Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/MockHLSAVPlayer.swift` and `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockPlayer.swift`) and carry `Mock`-prefixed type names (`MockHLSAVPlayer.play`, `MockPlayer.play`), making them test-fixture mock implementations despite the pipeline's `is_mock: false` / `is_test: false` flags. Consolidating these duplicate `play` methods into shared production code would couple production targets to test-fixture semantics. The duplication is intentional: each mock independently satisfies a distinct test contract (`HLSPlayerTests` vs. `PlaybackTestUtilities`) and should remain isolated to its respective test target.
